results.title: Fat
results.overview: A father obsessed with his own physique decides to force his overweight son to slim down, to the point of no return.

results.title: In This Room
results.overview: In a world that seems to be falling apart, poetry, empathy, and music remind us of the urgent need to understand one another. Through fado and the distinctive voice of its most famous singer, Carminho, a glimmer of hope emerges across the landscapes of a Japan once devastated by bombings. The film follows the Portuguese artist on tour across the country. Through concerts, backstage moments, hotel rooms, taxis, silences, and whispers, the film weaves together the world of fado and Japan’s cultural landscape.

results.title: Memory Box
results.overview: The film follows a teenage boy as he packs up his childhood bedroom, preparing to leave behind an important part of his life. As he comes across different objects, he is reminded of memories from his childhood and teenage years, with each memory representing a different emotion and experience that has shaped who he is.  The film explores themes of growing up, nostalgia, family, friendship, and the difficult emotions that come with change. It is a Bildungsroman, as the story focuses on the boy’s personal and emotional development as he reflects on his past and begins to understand how his experiences have shaped the person he is becoming. Ultimately, the film is about leaving childhood behind while recognising that those experiences will always remain a part of him.

results.title: Swipe White
results.overview: After impulsively posing as white on a dating app, Heem, a gay Black New Yorker, finds his ideal match. But as their romance blossoms, he must confront his lie to have a real shot at love.

results.title: Tina and the Fly
results.overview: After a terrible breakup, a woman develops a toxic codependent relationship with a house fly.

results.title: Krew
results.overview: A young film student joins a foreign horror film shooting in the woods, only to realize she can’t understand the language—or the dark rituals that may claim her as their final sacrifice.

results.title: The Other Room
results.overview: After a late-night Tinder hookup, a young Black man is cornered by his date's white parents whose wine and questions mask something far worse waiting in the other room.

results.title: The Suitcase
results.overview: During a gala, three friends stumble upon a suitcase filled with money and a dead body. Before they know it, they find themselves caught up in an unexpected and dangerous manhunt.

results.title: Home, Almost
results.overview: A story about an MMA fighter who finds himself in another fight on the way home. — with his father and younger brother by his side, finding the true meaning of family along the way.

results.title: Horizon
results.overview: As the twilight of adolescence gives way to adulthood, Casca, Ana, and Fú find themselves stalled on the roadside. The highway shifts before their eyes: a reverse road movie.

results.title: Conscience
results.overview: The filmmakers present the stories of ordinary people across three segments of this anthology film: "Trust," "Frenzy," and "Conscience." The lives of the protagonists have been ruthlessly ground down by a modern-day scourge: fraud.  Much is said and written today about the complex world of information technology and the importance of protecting oneself and one’s loved ones. Yet, not everyone possesses the caution, skepticism, wariness, and high level of awareness needed to stay safe; consequently, people of all ages and social backgrounds fall prey to scammers.

results.title: AAKHRI MULAQAT
results.overview: Aakhri Mulaqat follows a photojournalist's investigation into an illegal fake antibiotics racket. Meanwhile, tensions between two rival gangs escalate, fuelled by greed and revenge. As violence brings one conflict to an end, it sets the stage for another, in a cycle that never truly ends.

results.title: GALDR
results.overview: After joining GALDR, a dating app for magical folk, a young man posing as a Druid matches with a mysterious witch for a seemingly ordinary first date. But as the night unfolds, he's pulled into a world of danger and magical chaos far beyond what he could have ever expected.

results.title: Winter Wind
results.overview: When a ghostly stranger warns them of a deadly wind storm, a gang of thieves takes shelter in the very town they once robbed.

results.title: Tannenbaum
results.overview: Jake’s winter season takes an unexpected turn as he tries his best to give his daughter, ex-wife, and dog a memorable Christmas Day.

results.title: Stalling
results.overview: Minutes before a job interview, a man with a stubborn case of shy bladder becomes the center of an increasingly surreal restroom spectacle as every well-intention attempt to help only makes things worse.
